svg.aria-label: Full Heraldic Achievement of House Carmichael — IEHOVA SEMPER VIGILANS
svg.title: House of Carmichael Full Heraldic Achievement — IEHOVA SEMPER VIGILANS
svg.desc: Finalized House of Carmichael coat of arms bearing the official motto IEHOVA SEMPER VIGILANS; single bent dark-steel armored arm and articulated gauntlet gripping bright yellow heraldic lightning bolts and a slender green olive branch in homage to U.S. Air Force Strategic Air Command (SAC) service; gold shield with black displayed eagle, central silver Carmichael inescutcheon with twisted royal-blue and crimson wreathed fess, dark-green and gold inner border, ornate jewelled gold coronet, steel helm, and sweeping royal-blue, crimson, and burnished-gold acanthus mantling; supported on the left by a dignified African American knight in dark steel plate armor with subtle gold lightning-bolt trim wearing his steel helmet with visor raised and on the right by a crowned golden Barbary lion with a rich dark-brown and black mane, standing upon Scottish purple thistles and a braided gold-and-green heritage ribbon.
